event_name: Muckleshoot Casino Resort NHRA Northwest Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 75 degrees, relative humidity 47 percent, barometer 30.02 inches, adjusted altitude 1,690 feet, track temperature 111 degrees.

The #1 FC qualifier is 8 - 5 in the Final round at this event

J.R. Todd is 1 - 5 in Final rounds when qualified #1. His only win was at Indy in 2018 (Beat M. Hagan).

Prock is 8 - 3 against Todd in prior events and Prock is 2 - 1 against Todd in prior final rounds. 

Prock goes red to give Todd the win.  Prock then pushes out a head gasket and has a fire.

Todd is straight down the groove for the win.  He wins his first Wally this season and 23rd of his career and 16th in a Funny Car.
